card.title: Starpi Core (local companion)
card.subtitle: A service on this computer that keeps notes, documents and conversations sealed, signs every answer into a tamper-evident record and reaches language models only through hosts you listed. Start it with “starpi-companion start” and get a code with “starpi-companion pair”.

pair.connect: Connect the companion on this computer
pair.code_hint: 8 characters, shown by “starpi-companion pair”; valid for 10 minutes.
pair.self_hint: This app is served by the companion. Enter the code “starpi-companion pair” printed to pair this browser.
pair.lost: The companion no longer knows this browser (the session was ended or ran out). Pair again.
pair.network_hint: Your browser may ask whether this site may reach devices on your local network; allow it for the companion. If it refuses, open the app the companion serves instead (its address with no path).

probe.none: No companion answers at this address. Start it with “starpi-companion start”.

info.mode_hosted: This site, with a token kept sealed in this browser

source.enabled: Questions about sources also search the companion’s documents and notes
source.ceiling: What a model in the cloud may read from the companion
source.ceiling_hint: Sensitive passages are only used for questions answered on this device; secret ones never leave the companion.

unpair_confirm: Unpair this browser from the companion? Its session ends and this browser forgets the link. The companion keeps its data.
unpaired: This browser is no longer paired.

tab.unpaired_body: Pair Starpi Core on this computer under Settings to see its status, documents, notes and agenda here.

status.title: Status
status.egress_guarded: Guarded: only the hosts listed below can be reached.
status.egress_unguarded: The egress guard is not installed in this process.
status.egress_none: No hosts listed: the companion reaches nothing but this computer.
status.no_brains: No model configured: answers are templates.
status.head: Newest record

ask.title: Ask the companion
ask.hint: The companion answers with its own models and checks every sentence before it is shown. The conversation is kept sealed in the companion, not in this browser.
ask.question: Question
ask.label_free: General knowledge, not checked against sources
ask.withheld: {n} {n:sentence was|sentences were} withheld because no source supported {n:it|them}.
ask.approval: The model wants to use {tool}. Allow this call?
ask.delete_confirm: Delete this conversation in the companion?

notice.no_model: No language model is configured in the companion, so this is a template answer.
notice.class_secret: The question touches secret content, which no model may see.
notice.no_brain_for_class: No configured model may receive content of this class.
notice.brain_unavailable: The models allowed for this content are resting after errors; try again in a minute.
notice.brain_failed_midway: The model stopped in the middle of the answer.
notice.breaker: The companion is protecting itself under load and does not answer now.
notice.other: The companion answered with a template.

docs.title: Documents
docs.uploaded: The document was added; the companion reads it in the background.
docs.duplicate: The companion has this document already.
docs.delete_confirm: Delete this document from the companion?

notes.title: Notes
notes.delete_confirm: Delete this note from the companion?

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.incomplete: Give the reminder a title, and a date (once) or days (weekly).
agenda.text_monthly_last: monthly on the last day at {time}

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.live: New notifications show up here while this page is open.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.approve_confirm: Approve {tool} with the description the server shows now? Every call will still ask you first.

audit.title: Audit
audit.state_fork: Another history than this browser saw
audit.state_unsupported: This browser cannot check Ed25519 signatures
audit.explain: Every answer of the companion carries the newest record of its audit chain, signed with its key. This browser keeps the highest record it saw, so a companion whose data were put back to an older copy is noticed.
audit.findings: The verification found {n} {n:problem|problems}. Run “starpi-companion verify-audit” on the computer for details.
audit.banner_title: Audit rollback: the companion’s history does not match
audit.banner_rollback: The companion reports record {reported}, but this browser already saw record {stored}. Its data may have been put back to an older copy. Answers may be missing what was recorded since.
audit.banner_fork: The companion’s record {stored} differs from the one this browser saw, or is gone. Its data may have been replaced.
audit.banner_invalid: The signature on the companion’s answer does not match the key from pairing. Do not trust its answers; pair again only if you know why the key changed.
audit.accept: I restored it on purpose: accept
audit.accept_confirm: Accept the companion’s current history as the new reference? Do this only if you restored a backup yourself.
audit.accepted: The current history is the new reference.

devices.title: Paired devices
devices.revoke_confirm: End this session? The device has to pair again.

mcp.title: Desktop MCP clients
mcp.hint: A token lets a desktop application read through the companion’s read-only MCP server (search documents, read excerpts, recall notes, list the agenda). Save it in a file only you can read.
mcp.label: Name of the application

setup.title: Setup checks
setup.code_cloud_model: A cloud model is configured (not probed: checks never reach the internet).
setup.code_embeddings_unreachable: The embedding server does not answer; search ranks by keywords.
setup.code_keyword_only: No embedding server configured; search ranks by keywords alone.
setup.code_model_missing: The model server does not list the configured model.
setup.code_model_server_unreachable: The local model server does not answer.
setup.code_search_off: The search index is not loaded.
setup.code_voice_unreachable: The voice server does not answer.

error.other: The companion could not do that ({code}).
error.origin_invalid: Enter the companion’s address on this computer, such as http://127.0.0.1:47821.
error.unreachable: The companion does not answer. Is it running?
error.timeout: The companion took too long to answer.
error.bad_response: Something answered at this address, but not the companion.
error.not_a_companion: Something answered at this address, but not the companion.
error.identity_invalid: The companion’s key does not match its key id; pairing was stopped.
error.code_format: A pairing code has 8 letters and digits.
error.pairing_failed: The code is wrong or expired. Get a new one with “starpi-companion pair”.
error.origin_not_allowed: The companion does not allow this site. Add its address to “allowedOrigins” in the companion’s config.json, or open the app the companion serves.
error.unauthenticated: The companion no longer knows this browser. Pair again.
error.forbidden: Only an owner session may do this.
error.breaker_engaged: The companion is protecting itself under load and does not take this now.
error.module_stopped: This part of the companion is not running.
error.not_found: The companion does not have this.
error.body_too_large: That is too large for the companion.
error.unsupported_media_type: The companion does not take this kind of file.
error.document_type: The companion cannot read this kind of file.
error.documents_full: The companion holds as many documents as it may.
error.notes_full: The companion holds as many notes as it may.
error.agenda_rule: The repeat rule is not valid.
error.conversation_unknown: The companion no longer has this conversation.
error.conversation_full: This conversation is full; start a new one.
error.stream_failed: The answer stopped before it was complete.
error.approval_unknown: That call is no longer waiting.
error.pin_mismatch: The server describes this tool differently now. Refresh and look at the new description.
error.tool_unknown: The server does not offer this tool (refresh first).
error.mcp_clients_full: There are as many MCP clients as allowed.
error.notify_streams: Too many open inbox connections; close other tabs.
error.audit_seq_unknown: The companion has no such record.
